title: Education
sections:
Education and training

The formal part is below. The more useful half was never on a transcript — a decade of shipping, and the three courses I went back for once I knew which questions to ask.

1. 2019

    Interaction Design Foundation

    Certificate in design thinking. Went back for it after five years of practice.

  2. 2021

    Nielsen Norman Group

    UX research methods, in person. Changed how I run every study since.

  3. 2024

    Accessibility for designers

    WCAG in practice, not in theory. Now part of how I hand work over.

The rest is in the work

Case studies and talks say more about how I think than any of the above.
